description: Compare ANO5 48-64 with characterised dysferlin-complex membrane-binding peptides and test for complementary acidic patches in repair partners
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
s=requests.Session(); s.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 research-agent"})
P="prov"
ACC={"AHNAK":"Q09666","ANXA2":"P07355","S100A10":"P60903","DYSF":"O75923","MG53_TRIM72":"Q6ZMU5",
     "ANXA6":"P08133","ANXA5":"P08758","BVES_POPDC1":"Q8NE79"}
seq={}
for n,a in ACC.items():
    t=s.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta", timeout=60).text
    seq[n]="".join(t.splitlines()[1:])
json.dump(seq, open(f"{P}/repair_machinery_seqs.json","w"))
print({n:len(v) for n,v in seq.items()})
print("AHNAK 5654-5673 =", seq["AHNAK"][5653:5673])
print("ANXA2 1-14      =", seq["ANXA2"][:14])
print("BVES C-term 230-360 len", len(seq["BVES_POPDC1"][229:360]))

BASIC=set("KR"); HYD=set("FWYLIVM")
def netq(w): return sum({'K':1,'R':1,'D':-1,'E':-1}.get(c,0) for c in w)
def bh(w):
    return (sum(c in BASIC for c in w)*sum(c in HYD for c in w))/len(w)-sum(c in "DE" for c in w)
a5=json.load(open(f"{P}/anoctamin_seqs.json"))["ANO5"]
motif=a5[47:64]
cmp_rows=[dict(name="ANO5 48-64", seq=motif, net=netq(motif), BH=round(bh(motif),2)),
          dict(name="AHNAK 5654-5673 (membrane-binding)", seq=seq["AHNAK"][5653:5673],
               net=netq(seq["AHNAK"][5653:5673]), BH=round(bh(seq["AHNAK"][5653:5673]),2)),
          dict(name="ANXA2 1-14 (S100A10-binding)", seq=seq["ANXA2"][:14],
               net=netq(seq["ANXA2"][:14]), BH=round(bh(seq["ANXA2"][:14]),2))]
print(pd.DataFrame(cmp_rows).to_string(index=False))

# Most acidic 17-mer in each repair-complex partner: could it pair electrostatically with ANO5 48-64 (+6)?
W=17; rows=[]
for n,sq in seq.items():
    q=[netq(sq[i:i+W]) for i in range(len(sq)-W+1)]
    i=int(np.argmin(q))
    rows.append(dict(protein=n, length=len(sq), most_acidic_17mer=sq[i:i+W], pos=i+1, net=q[i],
                     mean_net_per17=round(float(np.mean(q)),2)))
ac=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("net")
ac.to_csv(f"{P}/repair_partner_acidic_windows.csv", index=False)
print("\n", ac.to_string(index=False))
pd.DataFrame(cmp_rows).to_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_vs_repair_motifs.csv", index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,4.3))
lab=[r["name"] for r in cmp_rows]; val=[r["net"] for r in cmp_rows]
ax[0].barh(range(3), val, color=["#d95f02","#1b9e77","#7570b3"])
ax[0].set_yticks(range(3)); ax[0].set_yticklabels(lab, fontsize=8)
ax[0].axvline(0, color="k", lw=.8); ax[0].set_xlabel("net charge of the motif")
ax[0].set_title("ANO5 48-64 against characterised repair-complex peptides")
ax[1].barh(range(len(ac)), ac.net, color="#7fb3d5")
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(ac))); ax[1].set_yticklabels(ac.protein, fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xlabel("net charge of the most acidic 17-residue window")
ax[1].set_title("Acidic patches available in repair-machinery partners")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
